Game Overview

Stickman Blockworld Parkour 2 puts players into a pixel experience centered on navigate a dynamic block world as two stickman brothers in a fast-paced parkour adventure. Master timing and strategy to overcome disappearing floors and moving obstacles. With user-friendly controls and engaging challenges, each level requires precision and quick thinking to reach portals and survive.
